reviews.title: Sound quality isn’t there for $100 but a good intro headset only fitting factory strap
reviews.comment:
If you’re using the factory strap and wanted these over the ear cans for extra immersion then you’ll probably be happy. But anything other than the factory strap and these won’t fit well. I can’t really hold that against the headset but did want to mention it as I found it mildly disappointing when I discovered that.
I did switch straps to truly test it out and its just okay. While it’s nice for the enhanced immersion and privacy the sound quality just ain’t there for $100. Also the mic is pretty useless since no matter what the Oculus is going to use it’s onboard mic for recording audio to the game so that’s really just a feature for the PC side of things and at the $100 price point there are much better offerings for a PC headset.
Bonus points for the well designed multiple cords to work with PC or VR but realistically these should only be purchased as an introductory audio solution for factory strap users and even then it’s a tough recommendation over just some “junk drawer ear buds” that we all have laying around.
